newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo government not to tap central bank - finmin.
newsitem.headline: Yugo government not to tap central bank - finmin.

text.p: Yugoslavia's government will not rely on the central bank funding to finance its public sector needs, the newly appointed Yugoslav Finance Minister said on Thursday.
"I will immediately forget the central bank as a source of financing budget deficits," Bozidar Gazivoda, told Reuters in an interview.
"Public sector needs must be financed from real sources only. We must forget any budget financing through the central bank," he added.

"This is not easy in an economy which had been brought to a halt with four years of sanctions. But we must raise output, open to the outside world and observe international rules of the game." -- Gordana Filipovic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 222 4254
